summary: Crypto sentiment is broadly bearish: Bitcoin, Ether, and major altcoins are falling, ETF outflows and whale selling are outweighing buying, and Solana has been rejected at channel resistance. Some isolated speculative tokens show strong volume or open-interest activity, but these are high-risk signals rather than confirmed bullish trends.
